scope: Targeted candidate-text comparison only; not exhaustive novelty or literature evidence.

matches.hypothesis: An explicit same-query ordered decoder-state/mask-evolution path can supply final confidence reliability evidence absent from the terminal head's direct inputs. Upstream implicit history exists; temporal necessity and trained efficacy are unknown.
matches.matched_control: First64distinct native TRAIN scenes/up to4 descriptions/seed1999/W2best, retained regardless of outcome. Parent/disabled/repeat, joint query permutation, earlier-history query roll/reverse and final-state repetition with identical cached inputs/weights.

matches.hypothesis: The native detached Boolean previous-mask cross-attention gate can hide GT target point mass from geometrically matched positive queries, preventing later refinement from reading excluded target evidence. A training-only continuous mask-probability attention prior could reopen the evidence/gradient path without added parameters or changing native inference.
matches.matched_control: Frozen W2 native TRAIN outputs and matching indices, exact Boolean gate versus all-valid attention and continuous log-mask-probability bias; same masks, queries, valid padding and annotated target mass. Repeat captures; report fallback and fully/partly locked targets without subset selection. Distinguish from G1 absolute quality targets, Y20 global gradient conflict, and Y23 language padding support.

matches.hypothesis: Explicit point-mass-weighted soft-mask change history across native decoder stages may supply query-confidence evidence beyond final-state readouts. Native utility and independence are unproven.
matches.matched_control: Identical final mask/query/features/masses with distinct intermediate histories; repeat/permutation/wrong-history controls; physical W2 and targeted historical source audit. Masks, losses, native128/argmax, fixed30/seed1999 and backbone unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: W2 predicts confidence at seven stages but never explicitly feeds that confidence into the next query refinement. A learned relative-confidence feedback direction may let later mask/query refinement use the current competition estimate. This is a recurrent architecture hypothesis; existing queries may already encode equivalent information and neither benefit nor improved calibration is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus q_next_input=q+(softmax(indis)[...,1]-mean_query(p))*v, v[256] initialized to exact zero without RNG. One shared vector and six feedback calls between the seven original prediction stages. No detach, threshold, selector, extra loss, temperature, feature subset, seed or epoch changes. All original confidence/mask/auxiliary losses and released SPFormer remain unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: W2 refines visual instance states with language at every decoder stage but predicts all masks against the same static x_mask features. A shared zero-initialized residual from the current refined visual state into each later mask feature tensor may ease conditional mask fitting. Queries already carry contextual information; missing information, novelty and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus mask_features_i=mask_features+clean(refined_visual_i)@W before the six loop prediction heads; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), padded rows zeroed, stage0 unchanged. Each call consumes current original ila_ffn output without accumulating previous residuals. Original shared confidence heads/targets/losses, mask-to-attention hard-gate algorithm, original SCG/k/gamma, query sampling, equal coarse/fine fusion, static x_mask, full inputs/existing2D data, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: The original sampled query state is successively transformed by six contextual refinement stages. A shared zero-initialized residual from that same query slot original state may ease fitting a balance between initial anchor identity and later contextual updates. Existing residual paths already retain information; information loss, novelty and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus q_i=q_after_original_qqa_ffn_i+(q_initial-q_after_original_qqa_ffn_i)@W before each of six loop predictions. W[256,256] is exactly zero without RNG (+65536 parameters); original stage0 query tensor is the same undetached anchor for all calls. Original static mask features, query positions/sampling, all input channels/existing2D, coarse/fine equal averaging, Boolean hard gate/SCG/k/gamma, shared confidence heads/targets/losses/selector, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML stay unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: The six existing query-language cross-attention outputs combine an incoming visual query with an attended-language update. A shared query-conditioned channel-wise gate on that existing update may ease fitting cross-modal updates. Native attention already depends on the query; no missing information, novelty or trained benefit is presumed.

W[256,256] is exactly zero without RNG (+65536). All six qla outputs and incoming q_visual tensors stay undetached; original qqa consumes the new tensor. Initial stage0, static mask features, original language padding, original discarded qla norm semantics, coarse/fine averaging/hard Boolean masks/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/selector, full original inputs/existing2D/released backbone/Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML stay unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: W2 applies one shared confidence head to initial and six refined queries without an explicit stage input. A learned stage-specific additive query offset may condition that same function on refinement stage while retaining head sharing. Queries may already encode stage; no missing information, novelty or efficacy is presumed.

Visual features and SCG already encode geometry; missing information, novelty and trained benefit are not presumed.
